### `media download`

Download media from messages, profile photos, stories or a file id.

The message is re-fetched before a byte is read, because a file_reference expires and the fix is a re-fetch rather than a retry. --resume continues from the .part sidecar, --connections runs parallel ranged readers, --verify checks every block against upload.getFileHashes, and --thumb stripped/vector costs no request at all. --read is opt-in: without it a view-once photo stays unviewed for the sender, and with it the consumption is irreversible.

```
tlgr media download [CHAT] [MSG_ID]... [OPTIONS]
```

**returns `Page[Downloaded]`**

| Argument | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CHAT` | chat | no | Chat holding the media. |
| `MSG_ID` | text | any number | Message ids, or `-`. |

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--album` | flag |  | Also fetch the message's album siblings. |
| `--allow-protected` | flag |  | Download content the chat marks as protected (noforwards). |
| `--background` | flag |  | Hand the transfer to the daemon and print a job id. |
| `--connections` | int | `1` | Parallel ranged readers. |
| `--all` | flag |  | Every item in the chat matching --type/--from/--since. |
| `--file-id` | text |  | Download by portable file id. |
| `--from` | user |  | Only media sent by this user. |
| `--map` | text |  | Fetch a static map preview. |
| `--max` | int | `100` | Cap the items fetched with --all. |
| `--name-template` | text | `{date}_{id}_{name}` | Naming pattern for --out-dir. |
| `--no-cdn` | flag |  | Debug: read from the master DC. |
| `--out` | path |  | Write to this exact file. |
| `--out-dir` | path |  | Write into this directory. |
| `--overwrite` | flag |  | Overwrite instead of uniquifying the name. |
| `--part-size` | int | `512` | Request size in KB. |
| `--play` | text |  | Refused: the daemon spawns no players. |
| `--profile` | chat |  | Download a peer's avatar. |
| `--quality` | text |  | Pick an alt_documents transcode. |
| `--range` | text |  | Byte range (`0-1M`, `5M-`). |
| `--read` | flag |  | Mark the media consumed afterwards (irreversible). |
| `--resume/--no-resume` | flag | `True` | Continue from the .part sidecar. |
| `--since` | datetime |  | Only after this time. |
| `--size` | text | `600x400` | Map/thumb size. |
| `--skip-existing` | flag |  | Skip when the target exists at the right size. |
| `--small` | flag |  | Small avatar variant. |
| `--stdout` | flag |  | Spool the bytes and report the path (see the note). |
| `--story` | text |  | Download a story's media. |
| `--thumb` | text |  | Fetch a thumbnail: stripped, vector, or a type. |
| `--type` | photo|video|media|file|link|music|voice|gif|round|chat-photo|all | `all` | Media filter for --all. |
| `--until` | datetime |  | Only before this time. |
| `--verify` | flag |  | Check the bytes against upload.getFileHashes. |
| `--web` | text |  | Fetch a web document through Telegram. |
| `--zoom` | int | `15` | Map zoom. |

Also invocable as: `tlgr dl`

```console
$ tlgr media download @alice 12345 --json
```

### `media export`

Archive a chat's media to disk with a resumable ledger.

The ledger under the output root maps document id to path, so an interrupted export resumes instead of starting again. --dry-run answers with the plan and its byte total before anything is fetched.

```
tlgr media export <CHAT> [OPTIONS]
```

**returns `ExportResult`**

| Argument | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CHAT` | chat | yes | Chat to archive. |

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--background/--no-background` | flag | `True` | Run in the daemon and return a job id. |
| `--connections` | int | `1` | Parallel readers per file. |
| `--dedupe/--no-dedupe` | flag | `True` | Write each document once and link duplicates. |
| `--from` | user |  | Only media from this sender. |
| `--jobs` | int | `2` | Concurrent files. |
| `--manifest` | path |  | JSONL manifest path. |
| `--max` | int |  | Stop after N items. |
| `--max-size` | text |  | Skip items larger than this. |
| `--name-template` | text | `{date}_{id}_{name}` | Output naming pattern. |
| `--out-dir` | path |  | Destination root. |
| `--since` | datetime |  | Start of the window. |
| `--skip-existing/--no-skip-existing` | flag | `True` | Resume: skip what the ledger already has. |
| `--type` | text |  | Which shared-media tabs to walk. |
| `--until` | datetime |  | End of the window. |

```console
$ tlgr media export @alice --type photo --json
```

### `media get`

Everything a message's media declares, without downloading a byte.

The JSON contract the whole group leans on: kind, mime, dimensions, duration, album membership, ids and access hash, protection and paid state. --sizes lists every thumbnail variant (the stripped and vector ones cost no request at all), --qualities the alt_documents transcodes, --stickers the sets baked into the image, --ads the sponsored inserts (listed, never viewed).

```
tlgr media get <CHAT> <MSG_ID> [OPTIONS]
```

**returns `MediaInfo`**

| Argument | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CHAT` | chat | yes | Chat holding the media. |
| `MSG_ID` | msg-id | yes | Message id. |

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--ads` | flag |  | List sponsored inserts (listed only, never viewed). |
| `--album` | flag |  | Report every sibling sharing grouped_id. |
| `--qualities` | flag |  | List the alt_documents video transcodes. |
| `--refresh/--no-refresh` | flag | `True` | Re-fetch the message so ids and paid state are current. |
| `--sizes` | flag |  | List every size/thumbnail variant. |
| `--stickers` | flag |  | List sticker sets baked into the photo/video. |

Also invocable as: `tlgr media info`

```console
$ tlgr media get @alice 12345 --json
```

### `media list`

Shared media of a chat, one media type at a time.

--type maps one-to-one onto Telegram's own tabs, including `chat-photo`, which is a group or channel's avatar history. --counts returns the per-tab counters, --calendar the per-day counts with a jump id, --ids-only bare ids so the result can drive `message forward`, `message delete` or `media download`.

```
tlgr media list <CHAT> [OPTIONS]
```

**paginated (`SEARCH` cursor) · returns `Page[MediaItem]`**

| Argument | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CHAT` | chat | yes | Chat to read. |

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--calendar` | flag |  | Per-day counts and jump ids instead of items. |
| `--counts` | flag |  | Per-type counters instead of items. |
| `--ids-only` | flag |  | Bare message ids, to pipe into another command. |
| `--month` | text |  | Month for --calendar. |
| `--positions` | flag |  | Sparse scrollbar positions. |
| `-q`, `--query` | text |  | Server-side search over name and caption. |
| `--since` | datetime |  | Only at/after this time. |
| `--topic` | msg-id |  | Restrict to a forum topic. |
| `--type` | photo|video|media|file|link|music|voice|gif|round|chat-photo|all | `media` | Which shared-media tab. |
| `--until` | datetime |  | Only before this time. |

Pagination is transport-level: `--limit/-n`, `--cursor TOKEN`, `--all` (walked inside the daemon, paced by the account's own rate limiter).

```console
$ tlgr media list @alice --type photo --json
```

### `media search`

Search media across every chat.

`messages.searchGlobal` paginates on the triple (offset_rate, offset_peer, offset_id) and a plain offset_id silently loops, so the cursor carries all three. An empty query with a --type is legal and is how the GUI fills its tabs. --sent is the attach dialog's recent files: one capped page, because the endpoint takes no offset.

```
tlgr media search [QUERY] [OPTIONS]
```

**paginated (`SEARCH` cursor) · returns `Page[MediaItem]`**

| Argument | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `QUERY` | text | no | Text to find. |

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--bot` | user |  | Inline bot for --source inline. |
| `--broadcasts-only` | flag |  | Only channels. |
| `--folder` | int |  | Restrict to a chat folder. |
| `--sent` | flag |  | Only your own recently-sent media (one capped page). |
| `--since` | datetime |  | Only at/after this time. |
| `--source` | any|saved|chats|inline | `any` | Music picker source. |
| `--type` | photo|video|media|file|link|music|voice|gif | `media` | Content-type tab. |
| `--until` | datetime |  | Only before this time. |

Pagination is transport-level: `--limit/-n`, `--cursor TOKEN`, `--all` (walked inside the daemon, paced by the account's own rate limiter).

```console
$ tlgr media search invoice --type file --json
```

### `media upload`

Send files as photo, video, document, audio, voice, round video or GIF.

The media half of the composer `message send --file` shares. The kind is sniffed from the bytes unless --as says otherwise; attributes are probed rather than guessed, because a video sent with duration 0 and 1x1 dimensions renders as a black rectangle everywhere. Two to ten paths become an album, uploaded item by item and sent as one group. --no-send stops after messages.uploadMedia and prints a file id the same bytes can be re-sent with.

```
tlgr media upload <CHAT> [PATH]... [OPTIONS]
```

**mutating · returns `Uploaded`**

| Argument | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CHAT` | chat | yes | Where to send it. |
| `PATH` | path | any number | Files; `-` is stdin. |

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--album/--no-album` | flag | `True` | Group 2..10 items into one message group. |
| `--attached-sticker` | text |  | Sticker already composited in (<set>/<n>). |
| `--background` | flag |  | Upload inside the daemon and print a job id. |
| `--caption` | text |  | Caption; repeat once per album item. |
| `--caption-above` | flag |  | Render the caption above the media. |
| `--caption-file` | path |  | Caption from a file. |
| `--clear-draft/--no-clear-draft` | flag | `True` | Clear the chat draft on success. |
| `--connections` | int | `4` | Parallel part uploaders. |
| `--cover` | text |  | Video cover photo. |
| `--dedupe` | flag |  | Ask the server for the file by hash and skip the upload. |
| `--dice` | text |  | Send an animated dice instead of a file. |
| `--duration` | duration |  | Explicit duration. |
| `--effect` | text |  | Animated message effect (private chats). |
| `--entities` | json |  | Explicit entities. |
| `--fetch-local` | flag |  | With --url: download locally first, then upload. |

| `--height` | int |  | Explicit height. |
| `--live-video` | path |  | Companion Live Photo video. |
| `--mime` | text |  | Override the MIME type. |

| `--no-action` | flag |  | Do not broadcast the 'sending a photo…' chat action. |
